== English Decipher comparison ==
Decipher limits non-Dengar deployment to your other bounty hunter and uses the target's defense value. The targeting cost, non-droid restriction and immediate capture remain.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=48 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 48. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=15 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 15.
